_comment: 第1弾24人の見た目。スキル絵に出す人物は必ずこの中の誰かにする（『どこかの騎士』を出さない）。data/cards.json のキャラ画像から起こしたもので、絵柄を変えてもここは変えないこと。skill_art_briefs.json の cast がこのキーを指す。
アイ: Ai, the Collective Wisdom: a calm young woman with very long emerald-green hair that streams out like ribbons, in a slim black-and-teal armoured bodysuit; shards of green-yellow light hang in the air around her.
ジエンド: Jiend, the Wicked Dragon King: only a colossal dragon's head manifests, deep teal-black scales edged in molten scarlet, long backswept horns, no body at all — it frays away into ragged smoke below the jaw.
クラウディア: Claudia, the Hero of Light: a tall blonde woman with a very long golden ponytail, tan-and-gold leather-and-plate armour with a bare midriff, carrying a straight sword; gold and white light follows her.
トランザード: Transard, the Rotting Demon King: a spiked, jagged black-blue armoured king whose silhouette looks like shattered obsidian, one cold blue light burning in his chest, his edges crumbling away.
オルス: Ors, the God of Battle: a broad dark-haired man with wild black hair, a worn navy coat over leather and a wide brown belt, carrying a long pole weapon; heavy, physical, unarmoured at the arms.
アニマ: Anima, the Dimension Drifter: a beast made of violet ink with no fixed body — jagged limbs, trailing tendrils, magenta slit eyes, and exactly three long claws on each hand.
レオン: Leon, the Avenger: a red-haired swordsman wreathed in orange fire, scorched dark armour and a straight sword, flame trailing from his shoulders and hair.
セレーナ: Serena, the Ice Queen: a pale woman with white hair and a crown of ice crystals, in a heavy white fur mantle over a deep blue gown.
ヤクビ: Yakubi, the Mad Bullet: a figure with messy black hair in a dark coat, wielding a strange long-barrelled pistol, surrounded by violet-magenta miasma and small shadow creatures with pink eyes.
フォギア: Foggia, the Hero of the Deep Green: an ancient elf with long white-green hair and beard, moss and lichen growing over his cloak and shoulders, carrying a longbow.
ストミー: Stomy, the Hero of a Thousand Spears: a young woman with short dark hair, a pale blue-and-white strapped tunic and a snowflake earring, carrying a long spear.
ディレイア: Direia, the Armoured Corpse: an empty suit of jagged crimson-and-violet armour with a red cape — nothing inside the helm but darkness.
ボーダン: Bodan, the Inversion: a heavily muscled figure split down the middle, one half burning red and the other icy blue.
グロウ: Glow, the Demon Vessel: a bare skeleton in tattered black cloth, wet red marks along the ribs.
ドッソ: Dosso, the Swamp King: a great mound of green swamp slime sliding over drowned stonework, blue water running beneath it.
パークル: Parkle, the Fire Cook: a cook in a white double-breasted chef's coat and black apron, whose hair and neckcloth stream upward as orange flame.
ビコウ: Bikou, the Jailed Soldier: a big heavily muscled man in a plain white shirt and worn prison trousers, calm-faced, iron lattice bars behind him.
ミルオン: Milon, the Mirror Shield: a brown-haired knight in dented grey plate carrying an enormous mirror-bright shield of ice.
ハスミール: Hasmir, the Hymn: a woman with very long dark-blue hair and a silver circlet, in a white-and-blue gown, always singing.
セヴン: Seven, the Half-Dragon: a red-haired boy with a yellow scarf, one dragon wing and a scaled tail, in light leather.
ダダ･ダ･ダ: Dada-da-da, the Composite Ogre: a hulking dark stone-and-iron golem crackling with white lightning, amber seams glowing between its plates.
オウー: Ou, the Great Glutton Bird: a genuinely enormous flightless bird, far bigger than a man — a huge round body of white and pink feathers on heavy legs, a small red crest, tiny useless wings and a cheerful open beak. Always draw it towering over the humans near it; it is never bird-sized.
ソーベルト: Sobert, the Mourner: an old man in a black mourning robe with gold trim, head bowed, a stone cross beside him.
ロッソ: Rosso, the Porter: a curly-haired boy in round glasses and a green cloak, an oversized chest strapped to his back.
